problem: Find the characteristic equation of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 \\ -8 & -6\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 2 \\ -8 & -6-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Then, the characteristic equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 2 \\ -8 & -6-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(-6-\lambda )-(-8)\cdot 2 & =0 \\ -12-2\lambda +6\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}+16 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+4\lambda +4 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
